diagnostics.label: unknown callee
causes: The callee is not a user function, known type constructor, enum variant, or builtin signature.

fixes.title: Declare the function or add a builtin signature for this API.

diagnostics.label: binding type mismatch
causes: Explicit `let` and `local` type annotations are source-level contracts and must match the initializer before Rust lowering.

fixes.title: Initialize `amount` with a `Int` value, or change the binding annotation.

diagnostics.summary: match arm has type `Result<T, PipelineError>`, expected `Int` from the first produced arm.
diagnostics.label: match arm type mismatch
causes: A match expression must produce one compatible value type across every arm.

fixes.title: Return the same value type from every match expression arm.

diagnostics.summary: arithmetic operators are only built in for numeric values.
diagnostics.label: operator on non-numeric value
causes: RSScript does not support user-defined operator overloads.

fixes.title: Use a named function such as `Type.add(left: read a, right: read b)`.

diagnostics.summary: arithmetic operators are only built in for numeric values.
diagnostics.label: operator on non-numeric value
causes: RSScript does not support user-defined operator overloads.

fixes.title: Use a named function such as `Type.add(left: read a, right: read b)`.

diagnostics.label: non-exhaustive match
causes: Supported match statements must cover `Some`/`None`, `Ok`/`Err`, all sum type variants, or include `_`.

fixes.title: Add the missing variant arm or a final `_` fallback.

diagnostics.summary: match pattern `Ok` cannot match scrutinee type `Option<Int>`.
diagnostics.label: match variant type mismatch
causes: RSScript match patterns must belong to the scrutinee's type.
